workflow: A search-like operation saves a pointer into a mutable byte buffer before fully converting its arguments.
Argument conversion invokes user-controlled code that clears or resizes the same buffer, releasing or relocating its storage.
The operation continues using the previously saved pointer without preserving the buffer’s lifetime.
The stale pointer is dereferenced, causing a use-after-free and process-terminating memory failure instead of a recoverable mutation error.
summary: Reentrant buffer mutation invalidates a retained operation pointer
